## 10. Independent evaluation without a second research pipeline per sentence

Independent Sol xhigh/Max evaluators inspect frozen outputs against the brief and governing primary evidence. They do not repair candidates. Let a paired evaluator reuse its primary-source research for both arms while keeping arm judgments independent and immutable before comparative selection; record imperfect blinding where prompts/output reveal the technique. Shared evaluation evidence is experiment efficiency, not free candidate assistance.

Keep full declared evaluation coverage for a source pass. A decisive failed screen can stop expensive exhaustive grading only if the remainder is explicitly UNASSESSED; do not imply comparable full grades from two failure labels. Use focused independent adjudication for material disputed findings; preserve the original judgment and publish the new review separately. Never keep commissioning graders until a pass appears.

Use compact coverage and defect records rather than rewriting the full source corpus, the brief, the draft and the same sixty clauses in several formats. Necessary detailed evidence stays linked and accessible. Do not make a new universal evaluation platform or semantic ledger a prerequisite.

For each arm, distinguish delivery, source assessment and coverage, time eligibility, method compliance, native/identity provenance, and resource/billing coverage. A known source failure cannot be rescued by good hashes. Missing billing does not negate a source-supported claim or a well-defined latency observation. A missing required native Goal means no native-Goal recipe qualification, even if the partial science is assessable.

Full source pass means no material unsupported claim, required omission, false rejection, or preservation loss was found under the declared assessment. It does not prove exhaustive correctness forever. Report nonmaterial limitations. Do not collapse this into an impossible demand for demonstrated application deployment.

## 12. Measurements and promotion

Record, using existing tools:

- T0 and actual setup/admission/queue/start/finish boundaries; last complete scientific artifact time when genuinely observable; otherwise the named request-to-quiet final proxy.
- Per-stage investigator/critic/finalizer duration and inter-stage waiting, with actual phase topology. Keep open-context lifetime separate from active provider activity where available.
- Summed created/started context occupancy, unions and overlap; no inference that overlap is free or that residency equals billed work.
- Input, cached-input subset, output, reasoning subset, cumulative Goal counters, subscription consumption and billing only where actually observable. Never add overlapping counters or convert unknowns to zero.
- Failed, missing, capped, invalid and interrupted attempts in the full denominator. A missing final has no zero-second delivery success.
- Candidate product cost, independent evaluation, preparation, support, publication and root observations separately; both product-path and complete experiment totals where supportable.
- Useful discoveries, material defect identities, source coverage, draft-to-final losses/corrections, and executable witnesses' actual domains/oracles.

Cold runs include source preparation; warm reuse uses an explicit denominator and does not import conclusions from other arms. Shared component inputs are one campaign preparation cost, but report their standalone preparation cost when interpreting a cold complete recipe. Do not invent a cold end-to-end total by summing unrelated medians.

Primary decisions: does the candidate maintain the complete assessed quality and improve user-visible completion time or failure-inclusive resource use? Report both, including trade-offs. Compare within matched case/provider/tier/contract strata. Faster FAIL and FAIL/FAIL are not equal-quality savings. Ratio of total candidate consumption to observed passing finals is a sample quotient, not expected retry cost or a billing claim; zero passes makes that quotient undefined.

For factorial blocks, report A1, A8 and their interaction without double-counting shared controls. For locked replications, show every original case, paired differences, all-assigned totals, failure-inclusive passing-output quotients, and dispersion. Four repetitions per recipe support limited empirical claims, not universal reliability or proof of non-inferiority. Do not multiply separate method speedups into an imaginary composite.

Select successors lexicographically by no material scope weakening, demonstrated source quality and completion, then failure-inclusive latency/resource trade-offs. Record the actual rule before selection and disclose ties/uncertainty. An observed 20–30% or 2× saving requires comparable quality and a repeatable signal; it is not established by a single fastest case. A valid scoped latency improvement can still have unknown affordability. The final may honestly recommend no new recipe.
